title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-Through into Consumer Prices
discussion_signal: The author describes direct import-price pass-through and slower indirect effects through domestic inputs, markups, and supply chains, making the consumer impact both distributed and delayed rather than a one-step tariff-to-shelf-price event.
linked_research_question: How do tariffs reach household prices through direct imports, domestic input costs, and changes in competitive markups over time?
